Follow these steps to get the most out of frame generation. Tap any screenshot to view it full size.
Tutorial content will be added soon. Drop your screenshots in res/drawable-nodpi and reference them in TutorialScreen.kt.

Welcome to DeepFG! It is strongly recommended to read the tutorial before using the app — it walks you through accessibility permissions, loading Lossless.dll, picking a target app and the overlay menu.\n\nYou can always reopen the tutorial later from the Tutorial entry on the home screen.
Choose how to open the in-game settings panel: a draggable floating icon, or a swipe-from-edge drawer.

On some devices the edge-swipe drawer may not respond, leaving you stuck on the overlay with no way to close it from inside the game. The floating icon is the recommended option. Continue with the drawer?

Hosts the overlay as a trusted accessibility surface so taps reach the app underneath on strict devices (e.g. Orange Pi 5 Ultra) where they would otherwise be blocked. Trade-off: while a session is running the overlay covers the status bar and navigation bar — you cannot pull down notifications or tap home/back. Leave OFF if your device passes taps already; turn ON only when you cannot tap through. Requires the DeepFG accessibility service to be enabled.

Extra fallback for the rare device where taps still don\'t reach the game even with trusted overlay on. The accessibility service replays the touch directly instead of relying on pass-through. Only take this if trusted overlay alone didn\'t fix tapping — enabling it when pass-through already works can cause duplicate taps.
MediaProjection captures through Android screen sharing. Shizuku and Root capture use a privileged UID-filtered target capture path, useful on devices whose MediaProjection includes overlays.
Show a live plot of generated frame intervals in the overlay. Useful for diagnosing stutter.
Number of frames produced per real frame. 2 = one interpolated frame between each pair. 3–4 recommended on mobile.
Internal motion estimation resolution. Lower = faster but less accurate.

Percentage of the display\'s native resolution to capture and render at. Lower values cut GPU cost across capture, frame-gen and every post-processing pass, at the cost of a softer image. Takes effect on the next capture (re)start.
Use the faster, lower-quality shader variant. Recommended on mid-range GPUs.
Enable only if your device and game output HDR.
Suppress generated frames during very fast camera movement to reduce missing character parts and warping. Off by default.

Use the half-precision shader variants pre-compiled inside Lossless.dll instead of the full-precision DXBC set. Reduces GPU load and memory bandwidth. Quality is virtually identical; falls back to FP32 automatically if anything goes wrong.
Show a small FPS readout in the top-left of the overlay. MediaProjection counts visible capture frames; Shizuku capture counts privileged UID-filtered target frames.
Choose where the in-game drawer handle appears on the overlay.
Pick the game or app you want to apply frame generation to. It will be launched when you start the session.
Pick the apps that should automatically show the DeepFG launcher when opened from the home screen. A small floating icon appears on top of the game; tap it to start the frame-generation overlay.
Enable the DeepFG accessibility service so the app can detect when one of the selected games is opened.
Disable Automatic Overlay for this app
Tap to start the DeepFG capture session for this app. Android will ask you to confirm screen recording.
The overlay permission is required. Please grant "Display over other apps".
The DeepFG accessibility service must be enabled so touches pass through the overlay.
Screen capture was denied. DeepFG cannot run without it.

On non-rooted Android, DeepFG cannot be injected into another app\'s Vulkan context like on Linux. MediaProjection provides the standard capture path; Shizuku capture can use a privileged UID-filtered target path on supported builds and requires Shizuku with ADB or wireless debugging active. See the README for details.
Optional. DeepFG renders at full opacity and forwards touches to the game without this service. Enable it only if you notice rendering issues on a specific device.
A report was saved. You can share it with the developer to help debug the issue. Device and extension info is already included — no personal data is attached.
No diagnostic log available yet — run a session first.
Runs three back-to-back passes (multiplier ×2, ×3, ×4) with a fixed preset and produces a shareable report. Use this baseline before/after performance changes to measure deltas.
Flow scale 0.70 · Performance mode ON · Anti-artifacts OFF · Post-processing OFF · Vsync AUTO
Each run: 60 seconds sampling + 2 seconds warmup. Total ~3 minutes plus target-app launch.
FP16 supported on this GPU — the benchmark will run twice (FP32 then FP16) for direct side-by-side numbers in the same report.
